verdict.rationale: The self-hosted Reader image bundles headless Chrome (gh-8), and docs claim clean output even for 'complex or dynamic pages' (docs-2), implying SPA/JS rendering support. However, a community commenter explicitly notes the website doesn't clearly document dynamic JS support, and no first-party doc or hands-on test explicitly confirms full SPA rendering works end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit documentation stating JS/SPA rendering is supported, a hands-on demonstration of a JS-heavy site being fully rendered, and resolution of the community's noted uncertainty about dynamic JS handling.
